name: Tsubaki Moegi
source:
Likes: Ii-kun (the protagonist), her older sister Amane
Dislikes: Bugs

Itsuki's hyperactive childhood friend. She's the kind of cliched childhood friend who comes to Itsuki's room to wake him up every day. Moegi has had feelings for Itsuki for a long time already, but she's not quite good at expressing her feelings. Unlike [url=/c36687]Rushia[/url], she is not good at cooking or cleaning.
